series_key: universal expert advisor: trading modes of strategies
mechanism: CTradeState stores ENUM_TRADE_STATE for every minute of a 7-day week (60*24*7 slots). SetTradeState fills a [time_begin,time_end]×day_of_week range; GetTradeState maps wall-clock datetime to the slot. Modes BuyAndSell / BuyOnly / SellOnly / NoNewEntry / Wait / Stop gate which of BuyInit, SellInit, BuySupport, SellSupport may run—calendar clock becomes an explicit trading-regime sensor.
data_needed: Wall-clock datetime (hour, minute, day_of_week); configured minute-mask of ENUM_TRADE_STATE; optional ALL_DAYS_OF_WEEK vs FRIDAY/SATURDAY/SUNDAY ranges.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: FORTS/MICEX session calendar (clearing 14:00–14:03, 18:45–18:59; open 10:00–10:01; overnight 23:50–9:59); Forex MA example conceptually; timer-driven EAs
why_new_for_mis: Turns exchange/session calendar into a dense minute-resolution regime mask (not just on/off hours)—MIS can emit Wait/Stop/NoNewEntry/directional-only states as first-class regime tags synchronized to clock.
quote: The CTradeState module stores the mask of trading states as the ENUM_TRADE_STATE array, in which the number of elements is equal to the number of minutes in a week (10,080 elements).

series_key: universal expert advisor: trading modes of strategies
mechanism: Author’s FORTS schedule maps known high-volatility and low-volatility clock windows to TRADE_WAIT or TRADE_NO_NEW_ENTRY: first minute after session open (price spikes), clearing gaps, overnight close, Friday after 15:00 (no new entries before weekend), Fri 23:40 STOP flatten, Sat/Sun WAIT regardless of holiday open. Pacific Forex session cited as classic low-volatility ignore-new-entries window.
data_needed: Session timetable per venue; day-of-week; optionally broker weekend-trade flag; ENUM_TRADE_STATE schedule.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: FORTS (MICEX) intraday clearings; Forex Pacific session; weekend/holiday opens with low statistical significance
why_new_for_mis: Volatility regime inferred from venue clock (open spike vs clearing dead vs weekend thin) rather than from a price vol estimator—MIS can fuse calendar vol priors with live vol sensors.
quote: Time of market opening. The moment of opening is characterized by high volatility and price spikes. Trading activities in these moments are associated with high risk, so in the first minutes after session opening it is better to refrain from trading

series_key: universal expert advisor: trading in a group and managing a portfolio of strategies
mechanism: CStrategyList deserializes Strategies.xml into multiple CStrategy instances (factory GetStrategy by name), fans OnTick/OnBookEvent/OnChartEvent to each, and exposes a panel to change TradeState / manual Buy-Sell. Portfolio of MovingAverage and BollingerBands on Si/SBRF/GAZR/ED is orchestration and UI, not a market sensor.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Si M1, SBRF M5, GAZR M15, ED M30; MovingAverage and BollingerBands strategies; Strategies.xml in common data folder
why_new_for_mis: No market sensing idea after full read—multi-EA XML portfolio container and panel only.
quote: With these sets or portfolios of strategies, you can flexibly and efficiently scale the trading process, while managing multiple trading algorithms located in the same executable module.

series_key: universal expert advisor: the event model and trading strategy prototype
mechanism: Intermediate EventProcessor unifies OnTick/OnTimer/OnBookEvent into MarketEvent {type, period, symbol} with ENUM_MARKET_EVENT_TYPE in {TICK, BAR_OPEN, TIMER, BOOK_EVENT}. Custom NewBar is synthesized (not a platform event). All Init*/Support* methods receive the same structure so multi-instrument strategies react to which symbol/TF fired, independent of which system handler caught it.
data_needed: Subscriptions via MarketBookAdd / timer; per-symbol CTickDetector and CBarDetector lists; MarketEvent fill on each detect.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Si-12.15 M1 demo; designed for arbitrary multi-symbol/multi-TF Expert Advisors
why_new_for_mis: Centralized cross-symbol tick/bar/book/timer event bus as a sensing substrate—MIS can treat BAR_OPEN/TICK identity+symbol as sequenced market micro-events rather than chart-local OnTick only.
quote: Indeed, if an Expert Advisor receives a notification of a new incoming tick, it does not matter whether the information is received through OnTick, OnTimer or OnBookEvent. The only thing that matters is that there is a new tick for the specified symbol.

series_key: universal expert advisor: the event model and trading strategy prototype
mechanism: CTickDetector::IsNewTick compares SymbolInfoTick last/time to cached MqlTick; CBarDetector::IsNewBar CopyTime(...,0,1) and fires when time[0]!=m_last_time. CStrategy::NewTickDetect/NewBarsDetect iterate detector collections and emit MARKET_EVENT_TICK / MARKET_EVENT_BAR_OPEN per configured symbol/TF—explicit change points for multi-asset sequences.
data_needed: Per watched symbol: last MqlTick; per symbol×timeframe: last bar open time via CopyTime.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: ExpertSymbol()+Timeframe() defaults; extensible AddTickEvent/AddBarOpenEvent for additional instruments/periods
why_new_for_mis: Reusable multi-symbol new-tick and new-bar change detectors as first-class MIS change sensors, not buried inside a single-chart OnTick.
quote: Returns true if for the given symbol and timeframe there is a new bar.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: Market bulls vs bears treated as opposed forces; ZigZag extrema locate cycle poles (max positive / max negative). Multiple ExtIndicator algorithms (standard Depth/Deviation/Backstep, Alex minSize/minPercent conditional-average trend, Ensign minBars/minSize, Tauber recursive global max/min fractal, Gann Swings by minBars trend order) all feed the same pole set for tooling. Recalc only when price leaves null-bar High/Low or new bar/history pump.
data_needed: OHLC bars; ExtIndicator choice; minBars/minSize/minPercent/ExtDeviation/ExtBackstep as applicable.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: MetaTrader 4 symbols generally; chart examples AUDNZD H4, EURUSD H4/D1; TFs from M5 through MN in DT mode
why_new_for_mis: Frames ZigZag not as a drawing gadget but as a multi-algorithm cycle-pole / swing-regime sensor—MIS can swap extremum detectors behind one pole interface.
quote: To find the cycle poles (extremums) on financial markets, we use ZigZag in our ZUP indicator. … Various graphical tools are used to research interactions between the cycle poles.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: DT mode (ExtIndicator 6/7/8/10) builds ZigZag from GrossPeriod higher-TF data and projects breakpoints onto the current smaller TF, marking constituent lower-TF bars that form each higher-TF candle. ZigZagHighLow chooses whether tools anchor to lower-TF bar extremes or to higher-TF ZigZag prices. Multiple ZUP instances overlay weekly vs daily structure on H4/D1.
data_needed: Current TF + GrossPeriod history (must be deeper than working TF); external ZigZag_* indicators; minBars/ExtDeviation/ExtBackstep; point colors for TF identity.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AUDNZD H4 from D1; EURUSD H4 with GrossPeriod 10080 (W1) and 1440 (D1); GrossPeriod ∈ {5,15,30,60,240,1440,10080,43200}
why_new_for_mis: Explicit higher-timeframe swing regime painted on a lower chart as a structural multi-scale sensor—MIS can tag HTF pole locations in LTF event time.
quote: In the DT mode, the current timeframe chart will show a ZigZag built on a larger timeframe.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: ExtIndicator=11 sweeps ZigZag Depth from minDepth..maxDepth (DirectionOfSearchMaxMin prefers large patterns first), builds ZigZag each Depth, searches Gartley/harmonic butterflies with ExtDeltaGartley tolerance and ExtCD CD/BC trigger; stops at first hit within maxBarToD of bar 0. Found Depth recalibrates displayed ZigZag; D-point range from BD vs XD=AD/XA mismatch treated as bulk formation then refined with Pesavento/Fibo filters.
data_needed: OHLC; minDepth/maxDepth; ExtDeltaGartley (default ~0.09); ExtCD; maxBarToD; ExtColorPatterns; infoTF for pattern name/Bullish|Bearish.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 example; harmonic Gartley models (bullish/bearish); processor-heavy on fast markets
why_new_for_mis: Depth-parameter search that lets the pattern calibrate the swing sensor—MIS can emit harmonic completion events (D near bar 0) as structured change candidates.
quote: Active scanning searches in the minBars (Depth). A ZigZag is built for each value of minBars (Depth). Then the Gartley Patterns are searched for on the ZigZag drawn.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: ZUP_RSI_v48 ExtIndicator=9 runs ZigZag on RSI series (minBars=RSI period, Price enum, minPercent in RSI points) in a subwindow; same Pesavento/Andrews tooling and bar-count-on-ray research attach to oscillator extrema rather than price.
data_needed: RSI(period, applied price); minPercent RSI-point threshold; subwindow rescale caveats.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD D1 with RSI window; experimental single-instance mode
why_new_for_mis: Swing-pole sensing lifted from price onto an oscillator feed—MIS can run the same extremum/tooling stack on RSI-space structure.
quote: ExtIndicator = 9 is an operation mode in a window under the chart containing RSI. … The ZigZag is drawn on RSI using a trend algorithm.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: Compute ray-length ratio (e.g. 34/23) between ZigZag peaks/troughs; if within ExtDelta of a chosen Fibo/Pesavento set (ExtFiboType/ExtFiboChoice, ExtDeltaType absolute or relative), label the canonical level and treat 2*Delta% as a predictable pivot area where price often stalls or turns. ExtHidden modes filter only in-set vs out-of-set ratios.
data_needed: ZigZag extrema prices; selected Fibo/Pesavento number set; ExtDelta in (0,1); ExtDeltaType 0–3; ExtFractal/ExtFractalEnd span.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD MN example (Nov 2005 0.382 near point 4); D1 illustrations; Larry Pesavento ~4% tolerance guidance
why_new_for_mis: Retracement-to-canonical-ratio with explicit Delta pivot band as a turn-likelihood sensor—MIS can flag when live swing ratios enter harmonic magnets.
quote: The Fibo levels are noticed to start "working" when the market approaches to a certain Fibo level. The market often stops or turns near a Fibo level. There is a kind of an area, within which the market behavior is rather predictable. The size of this area is expressed in percents and equals to 2*Delta.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: ExtPPWithBars modes enrich Pesavento labels: (3) bar-count time retracement = bars_ray2/bars_ray1; (4) clock-time retracement of ray development; (5) ratio of areas of rectangles whose diagonals are neighboring ZigZag rays; (6) points/% gap from break to nearest Fibo. Joint price-time-area geometry on swings.
data_needed: ZigZag ray bar counts and timestamps; rectangle width×height from ray endpoints; Fibo reference level.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/TF where ZUP ZigZag is drawn; demonstrated on EURUSD charts in series
why_new_for_mis: Adds time-retracement and ray-area ratio sensors beside price Fibonacci—MIS can score swing symmetry in duration and area, not only price ratio.
quote: 3 - shows in brackets the time retracement after the price retracement. The time retracement is calculated as ratio between the amount of bars on the second ZigZag ray and that on the first ZigZag ray. … 5 - shows in brackets the ratio between areas of rectangles constructed on two neighboring rays of ZigZag.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: Versum Levels: divide segment BC by Fibo fractions and ray from prior extremum A through those points. 50% VL coincides with Andrews median; price above/touching 50% → trend continuation bias; below → possible trend change. Dynamic VL updates with first ZigZag ray; treated as areas not 1-pip lines.
data_needed: ZigZag peaks A,B,C; ExtVLStaticColor/ExtVLDinamicColor; ExtVLStaticNum; standard or Pesavento VL number sets.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 dynamic VL example; works with Andrews' Pitchfork tooling in ZUP_v63
why_new_for_mis: Time-varying fan through BC with an explicit 50% trend-keep vs trend-change gate—MIS can read evolving median regime without waiting for classical channel completion.
quote: If the price touches or exceeds the level of the 50-% line (that passes through the point divided by 50-% level), so we can say (though not with a 100-% probability) that the trend keeps the same direction. If it is below 50-% line, we can say that the current trend may change...

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: For Alex/Ensign ZigZags (ExtIndicator 1–3), chHL=true draws acknowledge channel levels; a break of the opposite channel side is the condition that triggers drawing a new ZigZag ray—channel breach as the swing-change event. PeakDet shows prior ZigZag min/max levels as reference.
data_needed: ZigZag algorithm state; chHL_PeakDet_or_vts; channel high/low acknowledge lines; optional PeakDet prior extrema.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M30 screenshots in ZUP_v63 options section; Alex/Ensign parameter families
why_new_for_mis: Defines swing confirmation as opposite-side channel break rather than raw extremum print—MIS can delay regime-flip tags until acknowledge-channel invalidation.
quote: Using ZigZag ExtIndicator = 1, ExtIndicator = 2 and ExtIndicator = 3 and parameter chHL=true, you can show acknowledge levels in the chart. The acknowledge levels display the channel. If the price breaks the opposite side of the channel, the ZigZag will draw a new ray.

series_key: zup - universal zigzag with pesavento patterns
mechanism: Dynamic Fibo/Pitchfork/Arcs anchor to ZigZag ray 0/break 0 that moves with price and auto-rebuild; static tools lock to formed rays 2–9. Live dynamic envelope shows provisional trend targets while the active swing is incomplete; static envelope freezes completed structure. ExtFiboCorrectionExpansion switches correction vs Fisher-style expansion (Fe prefix).
data_needed: ZigZag ray index; ExtFiboDinamic/ExtFiboStatic/ExtFiboStaticNum; number sets; optional ExtArc* for arcs scaled by points-per-bar along anchor ray.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 dynamic and static Fibo screenshots; arcs MN; DT mode TF labels on Fibo values
why_new_for_mis: Splits structural regime geometry into live (incomplete swing) vs locked (completed swing) layers—MIS can maintain provisional vs confirmed Fibonacci regime maps.
quote: Dynamic graphical tools allow to make a quick decision. If the market turns, we will be able to see the possible trend looking at the shape of the dynamic graphical tool. As soon as the first ray of ZigZag changes, the dynamic graphical tool will be automatically rebuilt, too.
